shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عثمان بن خثيم
عبد الرحمن بن حسان بن ثابت

notes: three taḥwīl branches meet at «كلهم عن سفيان»; the shared tail is written once and belongs to all three branches
«أبيه» is a bare relation: the father is not named, so the last link is a relation (the Companion's father speaking)
«قبيصة» stands twice in the text; the third branch takes occurrence 2
